records.jp: いいなぁ、日菜子さんはスタイル良くて。<CR>細いけど痩せすぎてなくて、締まってるっていうか
records.en_original: I wish I had a figure like yours, Hinako. Thin but not too skinny, toned...
records.en: I wish I had a figure like yours, Hinako. Thin but not too skinny, toned...

records.jp: 愛央だって別に悪くないと思うけど
records.en_original: I don't think there's anything wrong with the way you are, Ao.
records.en: I don't think there's anything wrong with the way you are, Ao.

records.jp: いやぁ、そんなことないよ。<CR>だらしない生活送ってるし
records.en_original: That's not true. I'm kind of a slob.
records.en: That's not true. I'm kind of a slob.

records.jp: 水着ってさぁ、お腹隠せなくて困るよね。<CR>スカートタイプでも身体反らすと浮き出るし
records.en_original: You can't hide your tummy in a swimsuit. Even if you wear a swim dress, it'll show if you turn a certain way.
records.en: You can't hide your tummy in a swimsuit. Even if you wear a swim dress, it'll show if you turn a certain way.

records.jp: そ、そうなの？
records.en_original: R-really?
records.en: R-really?

records.jp: ピンときてない顔してる……恵まれてる人には<CR>わからないんだ。凡人の苦悩が
records.en_original: You don't get it... Blessed are those who know not the struggles of ordinary people.
records.en: You don't get it... Blessed are those who know not the struggles of ordinary people.

records.jp: わ、わかるよ！　食べるものとか気を遣ってたし、<CR>自主トレもしてた！
records.en_original: Of course I know the struggle! I always had to watch what I ate and work out all the time!
records.en: Of course I know the struggle! I always had to watch what I ate and work out all the time!

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: バレエの先生に、プロを目指すなら<CR>体型管理もできなきゃダメだって言われてたから
records.en_original: My ballet teacher always said I'd have to manage my physique if I ever wanted to go pro.
records.en: My ballet teacher always said I'd have to manage my physique if I ever wanted to go pro.

records.jp: 厳しい世界だなぁ
records.en_original: That sounds rough.
records.en: That sounds rough.

records.jp: 慣れちゃえば平気だけどね
records.en_original: It's not that bad once you're used to it.
records.en: It's not that bad once you're used to it.

records.jp: （そんな境地に至らないと<CR>その体型は手に入らないのか……）
records.en_original: (Do you have to go that far to get into that kind of shape...?)
records.en: (Do you have to go that far to get into that kind of shape...?)

records.jp: （でもそうなると、ちょっと誘惑したくなるのが<CR>人の心）
records.en_original: (That just makes me want to tempt her to be a little naughty.)
records.en: (That just makes me want to tempt her to be a little naughty.)

records.jp: 今は？
records.en_original: And what about now?
records.en: And what about now?

records.jp: 今は……特に何かやったりはしてないけど
records.en_original: Now... I don't really do anything special.
records.en: Now... I don't really do anything special.

records.jp: やっぱ体質じゃん。ずーるーい！
records.en_original: I knew it! You're just naturally fit. It's not fair!
records.en: I knew it! You're just naturally fit. It's not fair!

records.jp: そんなことないって！
records.en_original: For the last time, that's not true!
records.en: For the last time, that's not true!

records.jp: くっそ～、こうなったら誘惑しまくって<CR>仲間にひきずりこんでやる～
records.en_original: Ugh! I'm just gonna have to tempt you until you become one of us!
records.en: Ugh! I'm just gonna have to tempt you until you become one of us!

records.jp: 仲間、か
records.en_original: I don't think I'd mind that.
records.en: I don't think I'd mind that.

records.jp: いいの？　本当に仲間にしちゃうよ？
records.en_original: Oh? Well, if you're sure...
records.en: Oh? Well, if you're sure...

records.jp: あ、そうだ。日菜子さんを誘惑するのに<CR>うってつけのものがあったのに、忘れてきちゃった
records.en_original: Agh, I had the perfect thing to tempt you with, but I forgot to bring it.
records.en: Agh, I had the perfect thing to tempt you with, but I forgot to bring it.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What was it?
records.en: What was it?

records.jp: アイス
records.en_original: Ice cream.
records.en: Ice cream.

records.jp: え、ここで食べるつもりだったの？
records.en_original: Huh? You were going to eat ice cream here?
records.en: Huh? You were going to eat ice cream here?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: お風呂につかりながらアイスか……<CR>美味しそうだけど、食べてるうちに溶けちゃわない？
records.en_original: Eating ice cream while soaking in the bath does sound great... But wouldn't it melt?
records.en: Eating ice cream while soaking in the bath does sound great... But wouldn't it melt?

records.jp: じゃ、ジュースにしよ。凍らせておいてさ
records.en_original: How about juice, then? We can freeze it ahead of time.
records.en: How about juice, then? We can freeze it ahead of time.

records.jp: なるほど。溶けても美味しいものにすればいいのか
records.en_original: Good idea. It'll be good even if it melts.
records.en: Good idea. It'll be good even if it melts.

records.jp: ホットコーヒーとかココアにして、<CR>温めながら飲んでもいいかも
records.en_original: Something warm might be nice too. Like coffee, or hot cocoa.
records.en: Something warm might be nice too. Like coffee, or hot cocoa.

records.jp: ふっふっふ。<CR>日菜子さん意外とあるね、素質
records.en_original: Hehehe. You're more sophisticated than I thought, Hinako.
records.en: Hehehe. You're more sophisticated than I thought, Hinako.

records.jp: 何のことかはわからないけど、<CR>いい意味じゃないのはわかった
records.en_original: I'm not sure what you mean, but it doesn't sound like a compliment.
records.en: I'm not sure what you mean, but it doesn't sound like a compliment.

records.jp: 早く食べれば大丈夫
records.en_original: You just have to eat it quickly.
records.en: You just have to eat it quickly.

records.jp: 原始的な対処法だね。<CR>頭がキーンってならない？
records.en_original: That's not a very elegant solution. Wouldn't you get brain freeze?
records.en: That's not a very elegant solution. Wouldn't you get brain freeze?

records.jp: なんとかなるんじゃない？　お湯に浸かってるし
records.en_original: It'd be fine! The hot water would help counter it.
records.en: It'd be fine! The hot water would help counter it.

records.jp: 自信がないなら、私が食べるの手伝ってあげるよ
records.en_original: And if you can't finish it, I'd be happy to help!
records.en: And if you can't finish it, I'd be happy to help!

records.jp: それは大丈夫！
records.en_original: That won't be necessary!
records.en: That won't be necessary!

records.jp: あはは、そこは譲れないか
records.en_original: Ahaha, I guess it's elegant enough for you after all.
records.en: Ahaha, I guess it's elegant enough for you after all.

records.jp: にしてもさ、水着でお風呂に入れるっていいよね
records.en_original: It's nice to be able to get in the bath in a swimsuit.
records.en: It's nice to be able to get in the bath in a swimsuit.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: How come?
records.en: How come?

records.jp: 気まずくないから
records.en_original: It's not awkward.
records.en: It's not awkward.

records.jp: こういう時ってさ、目のやり場に困ったりしない？<CR>あんまりじろじろ見るのは悪いし
records.en_original: When I'm at a public bath, I never know where to look. I don't want to just stare at people.
records.en: When I'm at a public bath, I never know where to look. I don't want to just stare at people.

records.jp: さっき見てたでしょ
records.en_original: You were just staring at me, though!
records.en: You were just staring at me, though!

records.jp: 水着だからできるんだよ
records.en_original: But you're wearing a swimsuit, so it's fine.
records.en: But you're wearing a swimsuit, so it's fine.

records.jp: ふーん。<CR>愛央ってそんなこと気にするんだ
records.en_original: Huh. I didn't realize you thought about these things.
records.en: Huh. I didn't realize you thought about these things.

records.jp: 逆に気にしない？
records.en_original: You mean you never think about it?
records.en: You mean you never think about it?

records.jp: うん。同性だし、愛央だし
records.en_original: Not really. It's just you, and we're both girls.
records.en: Not really. It's just you, and we're both girls.

records.jp: 私だから？
records.en_original: It's just me?
records.en: It's just me?

records.jp: 裸とか、そんなこと気にする仲じゃないと<CR>思ってたんだけど……違った？
records.en_original: I thought we were close enough that being naked around each other wouldn't be an issue... Was I wrong?
records.en: I thought we were close enough that being naked around each other wouldn't be an issue... Was I wrong?

records.jp: ううん、そうだよね。今更か
records.en_original: No, not at all.
records.en: No, not at all.

records.jp: そんなに心を開いてもらえるなんて……<CR>嬉しいよ、日菜子さん
records.en_original: I'm really glad that you're opening up so much to me, Hinako.
records.en: I'm really glad that you're opening up so much to me, Hinako.

records.jp: そう言われると、ちょっと考え直したくなるなぁ
records.en_original: Now I'm thinking I might want to rephrase what I said...
records.en: Now I'm thinking I might want to rephrase what I said...

records.jp: えー、そんなぁ
records.en_original: What? No takebacks!
records.en: What? No takebacks!

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
